title: CurvFlow-DTA: dual-graph discrete Ricci curvature flow for drug--target affinity prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.22862v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph neural networks are widely used for drug--target affinity (DTA) prediction, and discrete Ricci curvature has recently been used to characterize molecular graph geometry. Existing curvature-aware DTA approaches mainly use static curvature on the drug graph while representing proteins primarily with sequence-derived features. This leaves pair-adaptive use of graph geometry underexplored, which may limit adaptation to unseen entities in cold-start settings relevant to practical screening.   We present CurvFlow-DTA, which replaces a single static curvature representation with weighted Forman curvature flow on both molecular and protein residue--residue contact graphs. A label-independent flow trajectory is precomputed for each entity, and a pair-conditioned selector determines the horizons read by a dual-branch Flow-GINE. A frozen ESM-2 supplies residue-level representations and contact scores used to construct the protein graph. Infer

translated_title: CurvFlow-DTA：基于双图离散Ricci曲率流的药物-靶标亲和力预测
translated_abstract: 图神经网络被广泛用于药物-靶标亲和力（DTA）预测，而离散Ricci曲率近来已被用于刻画分子图的几何特性。现有的曲率感知DTA方法主要在药物图上使用静态曲率，而对蛋白质则主要采用基于序列的特征表示。这使得图几何的“配对自适应”利用仍未被充分探索，可能限制模型在与实际筛选相关的冷启动场景中对未见实体的适应能力。我们提出CurvFlow-DTA，用加权Forman曲率流取代单一的静态曲率表示，并同时应用于分子图和蛋白质残基-残基接触图。系统为每个实体预先计算一条与标签无关的曲率流轨迹，由配对条件选择器决定双分支Flow-GINE读取的流时间视界。冻结的ESM-2提供残基级表示和接触得分，用于构建蛋白质图。推断……
tldr: CurvFlow-DTA通过在分子图和蛋白质残基接触图上同时应用加权Forman曲率流，并利用配对条件选择器与双分支Flow-GINE自适应读取不同流时间视界，实现了对图几何的配对自适应利用，从而改善药物-靶标亲和力预测，尤其在冷启动场景下表现突出。
en_tdlr: CurvFlow-DTA applies weighted Forman curvature flow to both molecular and protein residue-contact graphs, with a pair-conditioned selector and dual-branch Flow-GINE adaptively reading flow horizons, enabling pair-adaptive use of graph geometry for improved drug-target affinity prediction, especially in cold-start settings.
